ev.q: Reported rubella cases declined 97%, from 2000 (670,894 cases in 102 countries) to 2016 (22,361 cases in 165 countries).
In 2016, 22,361 rubella cases were reported to WHO, a 97% decrease from 670,894 cases reported in 2000
Global coverage with RCV increased from 21% in 2000 to 40% in 2012 and to 47% in 2016.
less than half (47%) of infants worldwide are vaccinated against rubella
Progress toward achieving the GVAP goal of rubella elimination in five of the six WHO regions by 2020 is not on track.
The number of countries reporting CRS cases increased 42%, from 2000 (75 countries) to 2012 (130)
